The winner of the most recently completed Formula 1 World Championship (the 2023 season) is **Max Verstappen**. 

Driving for Red Bull Racing, he dominated the season to secure his third consecutive Drivers' Championship. **Red Bull Racing** also won the 2023 Constructors' Championship. 

*(Note: The 2024 Formula 1 season is currently ongoing, and the champion for this year will be crowned at the end of the season in December).*
